name: How long does a bathroom renovation project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom renovation project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom renovation depends on its complexity. A small cosmetic update, like painting and fixture replacement, might take 1-2 weeks. A mid-range renovation involving tile work, new cabinetry, and plumbing adjustments typically takes 3-5 weeks. Larger projects, such as reconfiguring the layout or moving plumbing lines, can extend to 6-8 weeks or more. We establish a clear timeline upfront and keep you informed of progress throughout the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies: 1-2 weeks for minor updates, 3-5 weeks for mid-range, and 6-8+ weeks for major renovations. We provide clear timelines.
